attchmntText: Gujarat Apollo Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Gujarat Apollo Industries Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting commenced at 3:30 p.m. and concluded at 6:30 p.m. on November 14, 2026. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 251451 lakhs. Profit before tax stood at 86.04 lakhs, with profit after tax at 51.53 lakhs. Earnings per share were 0.40 for both basic and diluted metrics. Total assets as at September 30, 2026, were 29277.46 lakhs. Net cash flow from operating activities for the half year was 335.38 lakhs. Net cash flow from investing activities was 204.32 lakhs. Net cash flow from financing activities was 427.73 lakhs. The results include limited review reports prepared under Indian Accounting Standards.
